mindtree.actAssignHere: Give the selected items to this person
mindtree.actFocus: Show this branch on its own
mindtree.actNudge: Ask the owner for an update
mindtree.actPriorityHere: Give the selected items this priority
mindtree.actStatusHere: Give the selected items this status
mindtree.breachHint: Something under this branch is past its service deadline.
mindtree.breadcrumb: Where you are in the map
mindtree.byGroupHint: The same work counted once per group, added up across every track — the answer the map cannot give, because a group is drawn once inside each track.
mindtree.confirmBulkBody: They all move to ⁨{label}⁩, and there is no way to undo the batch.
mindtree.confirmCloseBody: It closes the item and takes it out of every open list on this screen.
mindtree.copiedToast: Map copied — paste it into your deck.
mindtree.dragCancelled: Left where it was — nothing moved.
mindtree.dragFailed: That could not be moved, so it is back where it started.
mindtree.dragGrabbed: Picked up ⁨{title}⁩. Use the arrow keys to choose a branch, Enter to drop it there, Escape to leave it where it was.

dragGrabbedMany.one: Picked up {count} item. Use the arrow keys to choose a branch, Enter to drop it there, Escape to leave it where it was.
dragGrabbedMany.other: Picked up {count} items. Use the arrow keys to choose a branch, Enter to drop them there, Escape to leave them where they were.

mindtree.dragKeyboardHint: To move an item: press Space on it, choose a branch with the arrow keys, then press Enter to drop it there or Escape to leave it where it was.
mindtree.dragNoTarget: There is nowhere to move it to from here. Go back a ring first.
mindtree.dropRefusedBranch: Only a single item can be moved. Drag one from the outer ring.
mindtree.dropRefusedTarget: Drop it onto a track or a group.
mindtree.dropRefusedUnknown: This workspace does not recognise that branch.
mindtree.dropUnchanged: It is already there — nothing moved.
mindtree.emptyFilteredHint: Clear a filter and the rest of the map comes back.
mindtree.emptyHint: Every track is clear. The moment something is captured, it grows a branch here.
mindtree.emptyTracksHint: An admin creates tracks from Settings, then Tracks.
mindtree.errCopy: Couldn't reach the clipboard. Download the file instead.
mindtree.errLoad: The map could not be loaded.
mindtree.exportCaptionFiltered: Filtered view — this is not the whole workspace.
mindtree.exportHint: The file carries the whole map at full size, captioned with the date and with any filters you have set.
mindtree.focusGone: That branch is no longer here, so the whole map is showing again.
mindtree.focusGoneTo: That branch is no longer here — showing ⁨{label}⁩ instead.
mindtree.keyboardHint: With a node focused: the up and down arrows move between neighbours, the right arrow opens a branch and the left arrow closes it, Enter opens an item, and Home and End jump to the first node and the last.
mindtree.legendBreach: A marked branch is holding work that has passed its service deadline.
mindtree.legendSize: A branch grows with the amount of work under it.
mindtree.mobileHint: On a small screen the map shows one ring at a time, at full size. Tap a branch to go a ring deeper, and use the trail above to come back.
mindtree.panHint: Drag to move the map. Pinch, or use the zoom buttons, to change its size.
mindtree.quickAddHint: Enter adds it and leaves the box open for the next one.
mindtree.quickAddQueued: ⁨{title}⁩ will be added under ⁨{label}⁩ once you are back online.
mindtree.selectHint: Ctrl and Space — or Ctrl and click — ticks an item so several travel together.
mindtree.selectionHint: Drag any one of them to move them all, or open a branch’s actions.
mindtree.showMore: show the rest of the work under ⁨{label}⁩
mindtree.subtitle: The shape of the open work — which track is carrying the most, where it is piling up, and what has gone past its deadline.
mindtree.summaryGroup: Across every track, the biggest group is ⁨{label}⁩ with {count}.
mindtree.title: Mindtree
mindtree.treeLabel: Open work by track, split inside each track by ⁨{label}⁩
mindtree.truncated: Only part of the workspace is loaded, so this map describes what is in view.
mindtree.whyDerived: This ring is worked out from dates and activity, so it cannot be set by hand.
mindtree.whyEmptyBranch: There is nothing under this branch.
mindtree.whyFocused: This is already the only branch showing.
mindtree.whyNoNudge: There is no one here to ask — the item is unassigned, or it is already yours.
mindtree.whyNoneEditable: None of the selected items can be changed.
mindtree.whyNotYours: Only the person who raised this, its owner, or an admin can change it.
mindtree.whyRetired: That branch is no longer in use and cannot take new work.
mindtree.whySignedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to make changes.
